name: smwblocks-water-level-ice-level-block
title: Water Level/Ice Level Block
description:
This block will change your level into either an ice level or a water level, depending on the ON/OFF Switch. If the switch is "ON", your level becomes an ice level. If the switch is "OFF", your level becomes a water level. This block will also enable sprite buoyancy for water level and disable it for ice level.

Demonstration Video: https://youtu.be/ecSMalNbYG0

Credit not needed, but appreciated. Just don't claim as your own.
